2124587562090246294.en_summary: The big question for $ANT from here is if growth is still exploding or starting to cool. $ANT says its yearly revenue pace jumped $10B in October alone, to $81B. Either way @GraniteShares has filed for $AIL (seeks 2x Anthropic's daily move) and $ANS seeks -2x.
